errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Please sign in again, then try once more.
errors.bad_request: Something went wrong with this upload. Please try again.
errors.too_large: This file is too big. The limit is {size}.

errors.too_many_pixels: This photo's dimensions are too large. Please use one under {megapixels, number} megapixels.
errors.invalid_image: This photo seems to be damaged and can't be opened. Please try another file.
errors.watermark_missing: Gallery photos are always published with your watermark. Please add a watermark logo in Settings first.
errors.watermark_unavailable: The watermark logo couldn't be loaded, so the photo wasn't published. Please upload the logo again in Settings.
errors.storage: The file couldn't be saved to storage. Please check the CDN settings, or try again in a moment.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.network: The connection was interrupted. Please check your internet connection and try again.

storageTest.ok: Connected. Files can be saved, read and deleted.
storageTest.config: The saved keys couldn't be read. Please enter them again.

storageTest.read: A test file was saved to {zone, select, private {private storage} other {public storage}} but couldn't be read back. Please check the key's permissions.
storageTest.url: Files are saved, but they don't open from the public address. Please check the CDN hostname.
storageTest.delete: The test file couldn't be deleted from {zone, select, private {private storage} other {public storage}}. Please check that the key is allowed to delete files.
